embeds.title: BLHA LEAGUE SUGGESTIONS
embeds.description: Ideas for improving the league, tracked from first post to final decision.

fields.name: HOW IT WORKS
fields.value: Start one post per idea and pick a topic tag. Owners discuss it in the post. Every idea shows where it stands with a status tag.

fields.name: STATUS TAGS
fields.value: **Idea** → **Discussion** → **Commissioner Review** → **Scheduled for Vote** → **Approved** or **Rejected** → **Implemented**. Only the Commissioner changes a status.

fields.name: THE PROCESS
fields.value: Material Amendments are proposed in writing, posted at least 7 days before voting, and approved by 8 of 12 votes in the offseason (Article XX).
